input.brief: Kargil Vijay Auto Service, Nagpur: multi-brand two-wheeler repair and service garage on Beltarodi Road — general service, engine repair, brake and clutch, rear suspension; free pickup and drop-off; step-by-step updates during servicing; open every day 10am-8pm

direction.name: The printed annual
direction.idea: Lay the page out like a well-designed printed report or magazine feature: a masthead image, a tight oversized title, text held to a strict column line, and colour used in solid blocks the way a two-colour print job would. It gives weight and authority to subjects that are really about content: findings, a manifesto, a programme, a serious product. The reader should feel that someone edited this.
direction.composition: A fixed vertical axis at about 42% of the viewport width organises everything: headings begin on it, body columns hang from it, and the 0–42% zone holds small side notes, figures or stays empty. Masthead: a wide image band (photographic mosaic or a single crop) across the top 45% of the first screen; below it the title at 7–9vw starting on the axis, with a two-sentence standfirst at 20–24px. Sections alternate between text pages (title on the axis, body in one or two columns of 34–40ch to its right) and full-bleed colour pages carrying one large figure, quotation or image mosaic. Mosaics are gutterless: photographs and flat colour tiles butted together in a 4- or 6-cell grid. Page numbers, running heads and other print furniture are left out.
direction.typography: A tight heavy grotesk or a sharp serif for titles; an excellent text face for reading at 18–20px with leading near 1.5. Headings in sentence case, tracked tight.
direction.colour: Paper, ink and two or three solid block colours. A colour page is a whole section in one flat colour.
direction.imagery: Photographs used as blocks in mosaics alongside flat colour tiles; mixed subjects are fine if cropped tight and converted to one treatment.
direction.photoTreatment: Give all photographs in a mosaic one treatment: greyscale via `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)`, or all full colour. Do not mix.
direction.richness: The column line, the mosaics and whole pages of colour give structure and variety without ornaments.
direction.pitfalls: The axis must be exact and reused everywhere or it reads as random indentation. Keep paragraphs to a real reading measure. On a phone the axis collapses to the left margin and side notes move inline above their paragraph.

hero.name: View with two cards in the corner
hero.blueprint: One photograph or muted film fills the viewport, `object-fit: cover`, with the subject in the right half. The headline sits on the left at mid-height: two lines at clamp(44px, 3.9vw, 60px), bold, leading 1.08, flush to the 32px margin on columns 1–5, the block vertically centred; 20px below it, one supporting sentence at 18px, max 40ch, in the paper colour. In the bottom-right corner, 32px from the right and bottom edges, two cards sit side by side with a 16px gap, each two columns wide (about 210px) at 3:2: a photograph of the newest thing (a project, an edition, an article) with a paper-colour bar 40px tall fused to its lower edge, holding its title at 16px on the left and a small arrow on the right. They are the next steps after the single action, which is a solid rectangle top-right beside a menu word. One short fact at 16px in the paper colour may be pinned onto the subject itself, beside a solid 8px dot on the point it describes, with no line joining them. Wordmark top-left on the 32px margin. If the left half is light, lay a neutral dark scrim under columns 1–6 only.
hero.mobile: The picture is re-cropped to portrait with the subject in the upper half. The headline sits at 9vw on two lines on the 16px margin at 44% of the height, with the sentence at 16px beneath it. The two cards sit side by side across the full width at the bottom, 16px from the edges, each about 171px wide at 3:2 with its title bar. Wordmark top-left; the action and a menu word top-right.
hero.headline: A plain two-line claim of 4–7 words, at most about 17 characters per line at 3.9vw.

type.note: One neo-grotesk doing everything: semibold headings pulled tight, small regular text, no capitals and no second voice. Suits software, hardware and studio pages that want to look exact and unshowy.

palette.name: Signal red, white
palette.note: White ground, black text and paper grey for filled panels, with one full black band allowed. Signal red is the only colour in the interface: one word in a headline, a few solid blocks, or the button.

photos.title: Desert and road
photos.note: dunes, dry land and open roads
photos.treatment: Give all photographs in a mosaic one treatment: greyscale via `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)`, or all full colour. Do not mix.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Lead line over four columns
sections.blueprint: Two parts on one 12-column grid with 20px margins. First, a lead paragraph of 30–40 words spans all 12 columns at clamp(22px, 2.2vw, 32px), regular weight, leading 1.2: three lines that read as the opening of a text, with no heading before it. 72px below, four equal columns (three grid columns each, 24px gutters) carry small text at 14–15px with leading 1.45. Each column is one paragraph of 40–70 words that opens with a bold run-in phrase of two or three words in full ink, the rest continuing on the same line in the soft ink. Columns top-align and end ragged at different depths. No cards, icons or dividers; the bold run-ins are the only markers. The four columns answer four plain questions: who, what, where, how to reach them. Padding is modest, 96px top and bottom, so a sheet of images can start straight after.
sections.mobile: The lead paragraph at 20px, full width. The four columns become a two-by-two grid with a 20px gutter and 40px row gap at 14px; if any paragraph exceeds 60 words, switch to one column with 32px between paragraphs. Run-in phrases stay bold.

sections.name: Mosaic of unlike tiles
sections.blueprint: A 12-column grid with 8px gaps and rows of 96px, filled with no empty cells and no outlines. Six to eight filled tiles in four sizes only: 6×5, 6×3, 3×3 and 3×2 (columns × rows). The rule that keeps it from being a card grid: no two neighbouring tiles hold the same kind of thing. One tile is the heading alone, two to four words at 4vw, top-left. One is a photograph covering its tile. One is a single figure at 6vw with a caption. One is a short list of four lines at 20px. The others are a single sentence each at 28–32px. Text sits top-left with 24px padding; tiles holding one sentence leave their lower half empty. Tile fills: the ground one tone darker, two palette colours, and photographs. One corner radius everywhere, either 0 or 8px.
sections.mobile: Two columns with 6px gaps. The heading tile and the photograph tile span both columns; sentence tiles span both at their natural height; the figure and list tiles sit side by side as a pair of squares. Order: heading, photograph, pair, sentence, sentence.

sections.name: Band of unequal panels
sections.blueprint: A modest heading, then one wide band of pictures. The heading, two to four words at 36–44px, starts at column 3, left of centre, with 64px beneath it. The band spans the full viewport width edge to edge and is 68svh tall: four photographs standing side by side with no gaps and deliberately unequal widths, a flex row with flex-grow values of 5, 2, 3 and 2. Each panel is cropped with object-fit: cover to a tall slice, so the band reads as one folded view. The first panel carries a two-line title at 28px in paper colour at its top-left, 24px in, over a neutral scrim that covers only that corner. Hovering a panel raises its flex-grow to 6 over 500ms while the others give way; without hover the widths simply stay. One caption line at 16px sits under the band at the left margin.
sections.mobile: The heading sits on the margin at 28px. The band becomes a two-by-two block with no gaps, 84svh tall in total: the first row split 64/36 and the second 36/64, so the slices stay unequal. The title stays on the first panel. No hover behaviour.

sections.name: The idea again, inverted
sections.blueprint: The close flips the page's colours: ink becomes the ground and the ground becomes the ink, across a full-bleed field at least 90svh tall. The page's opening idea returns as a headline of three to five words at 9–11vw on two lines, leading 0.9, flush left, positioned in the upper two-thirds; it should echo the hero's wording, not repeat it. Along the bottom, on one shared baseline 40px above the edge: one supporting sentence at 20px in columns 1–5 and one rectangular button in the accent colour, right-aligned in columns 10–12, about 56px tall. Nothing else: no image, no second button, no logo. The field's top edge is a hard horizontal line where it meets the section above. If the footer follows on the same inverted field, leave 160px before it so the close still reads as its own screen.
sections.mobile: The same inverted field at 80svh. Headline at 15vw on two lines at the top. The sentence sits lower at 17px, and the button spans the full width at the bottom, 56px tall, with 20px margins. Nothing else is added.

sections.name: Name first, places under it
sections.blueprint: The wordmark opens the footer instead of closing it. On a full-bleed field in the page's inverse or final chapter colour, the name spans the full content width as the first thing, its cap line pushed 8% above the footer's top edge so the tops of the letters are sliced off by the section (`overflow: hidden` and a negative top margin in `em`). 72px beneath, a two-part row: columns 1–5 list the places or ways to reach the studio (cities, or email and telephone), one per line at 32–36px in the accent ink, each a link; columns 7–12 hold three columns of small links at 15px, top-aligned with the first place. A final row 96px lower carries the legal line at the left and a back-to-top text link at the right, both 13px. The field is about 90svh tall, and nothing sits between the wordmark and the row but space.
sections.mobile: The sliced wordmark stays at the top, fitted to the width. Places follow as a list at 26px, then the link columns two across at 15px. Legal line and back-to-top link share the last row at 12px, at opposite margins.

references.name: Applied Imagination
references.idea: An essay conceived on a flight is read as a descent: an altimeter ticks from 30,000 ft to zero while you scroll down through halftone clouds to mountains at ground level.
references.hero: A pale blue sky fading to warm cream fills the viewport, with white clouds shaded in halftone dots. A tiny serif logotype sits top-centre; no nav. The title, two centred lines of black wedge-serif at 8.9vw, occupies the middle half of the screen and about 73% of its width; a cloud layer passes in front of the second line's baseline so the feet of the letters dissolve into dots. A two-line centred deck at 24px sits beneath. A mono byline strip is centred on the bottom edge with a scroll cue bottom-right. On the left edge at mid-height, a short vertical rule carries a two-line mono altitude readout.
references.type: fsKim, a sturdy wedge-serif display face, regular weight at 128px with -0.01em tracking for the title and pull quotes; gtAmerica at 24px for the deck and about 16px for essay body; gtAmericaMono uppercase around 11px with wide tracking for byline, altitude and tape labels.
references.colour: #cbe4f2 #f1e3b5 #0a0a0a #ffc013 #8e2f8f #f04e23 — Sky blue melting into sand yellow is the constant ground and text is black. Saturated magenta, orange and yellow arrive only in collage objects, tape labels and the footer contact card.
references.imagery: Photo-collage cut-outs (parachutes carrying a treasure chest and a burning dumpster, a pair of legs, mountains) given a coarse halftone dot screen, layered in front of and behind the type against painted clouds.
references.layout: A narrow text column about 38% wide for essay passages, interrupted by full-width display pull quotes and collage objects floating at the edges. One continuous sky instead of sections, with a fixed left-edge altimeter. Nearly 23 screens, ending on a ground-level landscape.

sections.description: Sky background, no container. A three-line pull quote in black wedge-serif at about 7vw is centred and tightly leaded. Two cut-out parachutes hang over it: a magenta one from the top-left carrying a chest spilling coins, an orange one at lower right carrying a burning dumpster, each overlapping letterforms. Small mono labels on tilted strips of coloured tape are stuck to the objects. Words in the quote turn from grey to black as they are reached.

Running essay text in about 16px grotesk, black, in a single column roughly 38% of the viewport wide, positioned left of centre with large sky margins on both sides. Paragraphs are separated by a blank line; serif sub-statements at about 28px introduce passages. The next display quote is seen rising from below, its letters partly hidden behind cloud and blurred.

Ground level: halftone-screened mountains in green and brown rise from both sides, and the title returns at huge scale, cropped by the top edge and tucked behind the peaks. Centred below is a square-cornered two-panel card: a cream left panel with a short form of two fields and a small orange button, and a magenta right panel with a round portrait, name and a yellow subscribe button. Yellow tape-strip credits sit on the bottom edge.

steal: Tie a persistent numeric readout to scroll position (altitude falling to zero) so the reader's progress becomes part of the story.
Layer an illustration element in front of the bottom of a giant title so the letters sink into the scene instead of sitting on top.
Apply one coarse halftone dot screen to every photo cut-out so collage pieces from different sources read as one illustration set.

references.name: The Queue
references.idea: An essay on queueing where the queue is the ornament: a line of drawn figures stands along the bottom of the hero and returns between chapters in changing period dress.
references.hero: Pinkish warm-grey page. A 12px mono breadcrumb sits top-left; there is no other navigation. The two-word title is set in a light serif at 200px (14vw), centred, its middle slightly above the viewport centre, spanning about 60% of the width with tight tracking. One centred line of grey 20px serif sits 40px beneath. The lower third stays empty until a single row of about 25 small greyscale drawn figures, each around 110px tall, stands on a hairline rule 20px above the bottom edge and runs the full width like a frieze.
references.type: Newsreader does everything: Light at 200px with -0.05em tracking for the title, regular near 30px for chapter headings, 18px body with open leading, and pale ghost numerals around 22vw. A monospace appears only in the breadcrumb and footer labels.
references.colour: #ebe4e0 #2b2622 #6f6763 #d9d2ce #16a05a — One warm rosy-grey ground throughout, brown-black text, mid-grey secondary lines, greyscale drawings. A single green appears only in the breadcrumb and one footer button.
references.imagery: Hand-drawn greyscale figures with fine outlines, standing in single file on a hairline; each band changes era costume and spacing. No boxes or backgrounds: figures sit directly on the page colour, full width.
references.layout: After the centred hero, text runs in one narrow column about 40% of the viewport wide, starting 30% from the left; the right third holds only a huge pale chapter numeral. Chapters are separated by full-width bands of figures on hairlines.

sections.description: Chapter block. A 30px serif question heads a text column about 590px wide, offset 30% from the left. Behind it in the top-right corner sits a chapter numeral roughly 22vw tall in a tint barely darker than the page, cropped by the section's top edge. Body is 18px serif at about 1.8 leading; bold run-in phrases open key paragraphs in place of subheads. No pull quotes, side notes or images inside the text.

Divider band between chapters: a full-width strip about 180px tall in which 10 to 15 drawn figures stand at uneven intervals on a 1px rule, with 120px of empty page above. The number and spacing of figures follow the story (few and scattered early, an evenly spaced orderly line later), so the divider carries part of the argument instead of acting as a spacer.

The ending switches voice. A white rounded promo bar with a blue pill button, then a heavy sans heading with a short grey paragraph and one green button, then a hairline, a mono uppercase label, and four small white cards in a row (thumbnail, mono number, bold title). It is narrower than the page and sits on a different axis from the essay column, so it reads as site furniture attached afterwards.

steal: Turn the subject into the section divider: a frieze of small figures on a hairline, redrawn for each chapter, in place of rules or spacers.
Set one serif family at three far-apart sizes (200px title, 30px heading, 18px body) and mark chapters with a pale 22vw numeral cropped off the corner.
Hold body text to a narrow column offset left of centre and leave the right third empty instead of filling it with sidebars.

references.name: SSTR - Friction Reduction
references.idea: Drilling hardware treated like precision consumer tech: a chamfered octagon taken from the tool's cross-section drives the buttons, icons and loader.
references.hero: The captured first viewport is the preloader: a 2 by 2 grid with hairline dividers, top-left quadrant solid orange with the slash-prefixed name at 5.6vw in black bold grotesk; top-right dark with a plus-sign dot grid and an orange square beside a percentage; bottom quadrants hold wireframe octagon stacks under small labels. The real hero is a full-bleed grey 3D render of a steel downhole tool rising from bottom centre. A two-line uppercase headline at about 3.5vw in light grotesk sits left-anchored at mid-height, with a short paragraph and an orange chamfered-corner button below. A slim bar holds logo left, five small caps links, globe and contact right.
references.type: ABC Monument Grotesk: bold for the loader mark, but headlines are regular or light uppercase with tight tracking at roughly 36 to 50px over 14px body. Uppercase labels at 10 to 11px carry a square orange bullet. Statistic numerals jump to about 6.7vw in a thin weight.
references.colour: #18191b #eff0f1 #ff5a2a #2f3032 #c3c4c8 — Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate; one safety orange marks buttons, bullets, the loader block and the highlighted chart series. Renders are desaturated steel so orange never competes.
references.imagery: Desaturated 3D renders of drilling tools, full-bleed in the hero and as a long drill string bending along a well path; thin wireframe octagon line drawings as service icons; a chart drawn in dots.
references.layout: Content sits inside vertical hairline rails about 35px in from each edge, with sections subdivided into two or three bordered cells. Dark and light sections alternate. Text blocks are left-aligned and narrow; a pinned well-path sequence breaks the grid with a full-bleed scene.

sections.description: Light grey section inside vertical hairline rails. An uppercase two-line heading at about 2.4vw sits top-left with an orange chamfered button under it. Below, three equal columns divided by hairlines, each about 230px tall: a wireframe line drawing of stacked octagons in the upper half, then an uppercase title at 13px and three lines of small grey body. No fills, no icon circles, no shadows.

Graphite section split into two bordered cells. Left cell, vertically centred: a tiny bracketed before-and-after range in caps, a statistic at about 6.7vw in thin grotesk, a one-word label and an orange chamfered button. Right cell: a line chart drawn entirely in dots, white for the baseline and orange for the improved run, with faint axis labels and a two-item legend using short colour bars.

Pinned full-viewport dark scene. A 3D drill string enters at top-left, runs down, bends through ninety degrees and continues along the bottom to the right edge, with bright tool segments spaced along it. A text block right of centre holds a small orange-bulleted label, a four-line uppercase statement at about 2vw and two lines of body. Bottom edge: a back-to-start link left, a chevron scroll cue centre, a skip link right.

steal: Derive one shape from the product (here a chamfered octagon) and reuse it for button corners, icons and loader graphics.
Draw charts with dots rather than lines and reserve the accent colour for the one data series you want read.
Turn the preloader into a branded four-cell grid that previews the site's colour blocks and wireframe icons.
references.media: A full-bleed 13s monochrome loop of a drilling tool descending over grey sand covers the whole fold with the text straight on it at the left, oversized for parallax. Below: a full-bleed WebGL chapter with the caption right of centre and a depth gauge at the edge, line-drawn icons in three equal cells, dot-plot charts beside big figures zigzagging per row, a 4:1 product strip under a giant product-code heading, and 3:2 case photographs in a right-hand column; 33 images and 3 videos, 0px radius.
references.motion: On desktop the video plays from 400ms while every text line shows as a solid orange bar the size of the line, like redaction, and the type replaces the bars by 1.2s. Under Lenis the hero video parallaxes at scrub 2, heads rise as masked lines over 0.6-0.82s expo.out at a 0.04-0.06 stagger, chart dots switch on one by one (1004 rects at 0.15s), stats roll digit columns, the WebGL chapter is step-locked with skip controls, and buttons fill with a clip-path sweep over 0.375s; there are 10 reduced-motion rules.
